summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), following the spec's seven-step procedure. Added test/test_extras/test_shacl.py with a module-scoped Turtle fixture, one parametrized test covering valid and invalid shapes (including graph-unchanged checks), and a separate test for None and plain-string inputs. Ran the new tests together with test/test_path.py using the generator venv: 40 passed, 0 failed. Lines are within 88 columns. black, isort, and mypy are not in the shared venv, so formatting and type-ignore placement were not checked by those tools. Nothing was committed, and no existing files were changed.
